headline: HOU @ TEX matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is HOU 3.62 at TEX 3.76, with a projected total of 7.37. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward HOU: HOU moved +0.27 runs while TEX moved -0.68, changing the projected margin by +0.95 runs. The projected total fell -0.41, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +15.6%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Spencer Arrighetti has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 0.6 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Ezequiel Duran, Jake Burger, Cam Smith, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Zach Cole, Andrew McCutchen because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
